title: Community Rules & Site Care Schedule of Enforcement Charges
content:
This schedule sets the plan figures used for self-help maintenance and repeat violations under Community Rules & Site Care. Figures are in US dollars unless stated otherwise.

## Self-help maintenance

| Plan | Administration fee added to each self-help cure |
|---|---|
| Self-Maintained Site | $35.00 |
| Lawn Mowing Plan | $35.00 |
| Lawn & Trim Plan | $30.00 |
| Full Lawn Care Plan | $25.00 |
| Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan | $25.00 |
| Complete Site Care Plan | $0.00 |

| Term | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Rule classes in which the community may perform an uncured cure itself and charge the resident | lawn and landscaping; debris and storage; snow and ice |
| What the self-help charge is built from | the contractor's invoice, being the invoice of the contractor who did the work |

## Repeat violations

| Term | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Trailing window within which a later notice in the same rule class counts as a repeat | 12 months |
| Charge for the second notice in the same rule class within the window, where repeat charges are permitted | $50.00 |
| Charge for each third and later notice in the same rule class within the window, where repeat charges are permitted | $100.00 |

## Notes

- The administration fee is the only figure in this schedule that differs by plan; it falls as the plan includes more upkeep and is $0.00 on the Complete Site Care Plan.
- Home exterior, vehicles and parking, pets and unapproved structure are not self-help rule classes.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** Within the same rule class and the 12-month window, a second notice corresponds to the $50.00 figure and a fourth notice to the $100.00 figure.
